title.narrative: OEG - IR-Resilience and Economic Growth in Arid Lands-Improving Resilience (REGAL-IR)

description.narrative: (Kenya): .The goal of the REGAL-IR mechanism is to reduce hunger and poverty, increase resilience and social stability, and build a foundation for economic growth among pastoral communities in five counties of northern Kenya. Pastoralist communities, which predominantly inhabit these counties, are vulnerable to recurring and chronic droughts and have high poverty rates ranging between 49 to 94 percent...FY 2016 funding will support interventions in livelihoods and livestock value chain development, natural resource management, conflict mitigation, drought management, and improved nutrition in the targeted counties. These activities will contribute to achieving the mechanism's community resilience building goals, which include mitigation of, adaptation to, and recovery from shocks and stresses in a manner that reduces chronic vulnerability and facilitates inclusive growth. .....
